verification_note: Scheme details change frequently. AgriN shows the official portal for every scheme; farmers must confirm current eligibility and dates there or at the local agriculture office. Entries here should be refreshed by the scheme-sync job (see docs/ARCHITECTURE.md).

schemes.name: PM-KISAN
schemes.summary: Direct income support of Rs 6,000 per year in three instalments to eligible landholding farmer families.
schemes.how_to_apply: Register at the PM-KISAN portal or through the Common Service Centre / village revenue officer with Aadhaar-linked bank account and land records.

schemes.name: PM Fasal Bima Yojana (crop insurance)
schemes.summary: Subsidised crop insurance against yield loss from drought, flood, pests and disease. Enrolment deadlines apply per season (typically before sowing/early season).
schemes.how_to_apply: Enrol through your bank, CSC or the PMFBY portal before the cut-off date for the crop and season.

schemes.name: Soil Health Card scheme
schemes.summary: Free soil testing and crop-wise nutrient recommendations issued to farmers.
schemes.how_to_apply: Contact the Block Agriculture Office or KVK to have soil sampled; download the card from the SHC portal.

schemes.name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY)
schemes.summary: Support for cluster-based organic farming, certification (PGS) and inputs such as bio-fertilisers.
schemes.how_to_apply: Form or join a cluster of ~50 farmers through the state agriculture department.

schemes.name: PMKSY - Per Drop More Crop (micro-irrigation)
schemes.summary: Subsidy for drip and sprinkler systems to save water and raise yield.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply via the state horticulture/agriculture department micro-irrigation portal.

schemes.name: Kisan Credit Card
schemes.summary: Low-interest short-term credit for cultivation, including dairy and fisheries working capital.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply at any commercial, cooperative or regional rural bank with land documents.

schemes.name: Rashtriya Gokul Mission / National Livestock Mission
schemes.summary: Support for indigenous cattle breeding, dairy units and fodder development.
schemes.how_to_apply: Contact the District Animal Husbandry Department or local dairy cooperative.

schemes.name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund
schemes.summary: Interest subvention loans for cold storage, warehouses, sorting/grading and primary processing.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply via the AIF portal through a participating bank.

schemes.name: PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME)
schemes.summary: Credit-linked subsidy for micro food-processing units, including branding and marketing support.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply on the PMFME portal or through the state nodal agency / District Resource Person.

schemes.name: PM-KUSUM (solar pumps)
schemes.summary: Subsidy on solar irrigation pumps and grid-connected solar for farmers.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply through the state renewable-energy agency / DISCOM.

schemes.name: eNAM - National Agriculture Market
schemes.summary: Online trading platform linking mandis for transparent price discovery and wider buyer access.
schemes.how_to_apply: Register as a farmer at your nearest eNAM-integrated mandi or on the eNAM portal.

schemes.name: Plano Safra (agricultural credit)
schemes.summary: Annual government credit plan with subsidised rural credit lines including for family and sustainable agriculture.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply through banks (Banco do Brasil, BNDES agents) with your DAP/CAF registration.

schemes.name: PRONAF (family farming credit)
schemes.how_to_apply: Obtain the CAF registration and apply at a participating bank.

schemes.name: Plano ABC+ (low-carbon agriculture)
schemes.summary: Credit and support for regenerative and low-carbon practices (no-till, integrated crop-livestock-forest, biological inputs).
schemes.how_to_apply: Through Plano Safra ABC credit lines at participating banks.

schemes.name: PAA / PNAE (public food purchase)
schemes.summary: Government purchase of family-farm produce for public programmes such as school meals.
schemes.how_to_apply: Register through your cooperative or municipal secretariat of agriculture.

schemes.name: Preferential agricultural loans
schemes.summary: Subsidised short- and long-term loans for agricultural producers via authorised banks.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply at an authorised bank (e.g. Rosselkhozbank) and confirm the subsidy programme with the regional agriculture ministry.

schemes.name: Agrostartup grants (small farms)
schemes.summary: Grants for starting or developing small farms and processing.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply through the regional ministry of agriculture competition.

schemes.name: Farm machinery purchase subsidy
schemes.summary: Subsidy for purchasing approved farm machinery, including water-saving irrigation equipment.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply through the county agricultural and rural affairs bureau.

schemes.name: Black soil conservation and formula fertilization
schemes.summary: Support for soil testing, organic fertiliser use and conservation tillage.
schemes.how_to_apply: Through the county agro-technology extension centre.
